R1181.note: gorilla/csrf middleware genuinely blocks forged requests, but no token-issuance endpoint/client change is added or even mentioned, so every legitimate JSON POST now silently gets 403 since it never carries a CSRF token.

R1182.note: Correct unsigned bounds check against frameBuffer.size() before memcpy; nothing else changed.

R1183.note: eval replaced with mathjs evaluate() in a try/catch; behavior narrowing to math-only expressions is the intended fix and is disclosed.

R1184.note: Generic client message plus server-side SLF4J logging; clean.

R1185.note: Standard erase-returns-next-iterator idiom; preserves order and evaluates every element per the stated contract.

R1186.note: Pins ValidAlgorithms to HmacSha256, matching the SymmetricSecurityKey already configured; no other behavior change.

R1187.note: Narrows the CSRF ignore pattern to /api/webhooks/** to match the existing authorization exemption exactly; minimal, clean diff.

R1188.note: weak_ptr/shared_ptr ownership fix is the standard remediation; subscribe() signature change is openly stated and both call sites (event_bus.cpp, sensor_monitor.cpp) are updated consistently.

R1189.note: snprintf with explicit truncation/overflow rejection; failure is surfaced via the same -1 return convention already used elsewhere in the function, so it isn't silent.

R1190.note: Allowlist map for ORDER BY column names keeps AccountId/Query as bound parameters and defaults to created_at as required; relies on Dictionary/StringComparer without an explicit using directive shown, likely fine under modern ImplicitUsings defaults but worth flagging.

R1191.note: The recomputed-offset logic is correct, but both the 'vulnerable' and 'fixed' code blocks mistype the function as returning void while still containing 'return -1;'/'return 0;', which would not compile as written (the real file declares int).

R1192.note: Shell invocation replaced with an argument-array exec.CommandContext plus IP/DNS host validation and a timeout; all changes are disclosed.

R1193.note: Closes the session-binding gap but via a hand-rolled, non-constant-time token comparison that bypasses the csrf-csrf library's own getSessionIdentifier option (which the file's own comment says is the missing piece), and leaves the sibling /email route on the same unbound middleware.

R1194.note: Validates via magic-byte content detection (file-type) after upload, discards client-supplied filename/extension, and cleans up rejected files; changes are disclosed.

R1195.note: finfo-based content-type detection with a server-generated filename closes the double-extension bypass; behavior change (discarding original filename) is disclosed.

R1196.note: {{ }} fully closes the XSS, but the contract requires allowed formatting to survive sanitization when rich text is supported (field is named descriptionHtml); the fix instead flattens all HTML to escaped plain text and only notes sanitization as an optional follow-up rather than implementing it.
